description:
As a shopper
  I want to add items to the cart on the demo web app
  So that the cart reflects the added items and totals

elements.name: Add first product to cart and verify it appears in cart

steps.name: the demo web app is running
I am on the demo shop home page
I add the first product to the cart
I go to the cart page
I should see the product in the cart with quantity 1
the total price should equal the product price

name: Demo web-app cart
